experiment.expected: an absence claim rests on an observer that has demonstrated both directions
experiment.observed: the claim '0. No body edit' rests on rest-events-edited (issues/72/events), a surface that cannot carry a body revision at all: `edited` in that payload is a COMMENT event. Read it instead with gh api graphql -f query='{repository(owner:"OWNER",name:"REPO"){issue(number:N){userContentEdits(first:20){totalCount nodes{editedAt editor{login}}}}}}' -- userContentEdits.totalCount counts the ORIGINAL revision: 0 is ABSENT, the first edit moves it 0 -> 2, and every later edit by one (ed3c/skill-concerns#102). So subtract one before calling anything an edit count, and read the editor logins in the same query - counted alone, an automation edit and a hand edit are the same number

findings.both_directions: positive: the same call site on an issue whose body was edited must report the edit; negative: on an issue with no body edit it must report zero
